slides.visual_description: The Economic and Structural Reality of Modern Healthcare — Explain the major economic and organizational shifts shaping physician practice, including rising national health expenditures and the movement from independent practice toward employment within large health systems.

slides.visual_description: The Human Cost: Waste, Administrative Friction, and Burnout — Interpret how system inefficiency and administrative burden contribute to waste and physician burnout, and identify why these pressures represent system-design problems rather than individual resilience failures.
